description: Land (Phase 6a, ARCHITECTURE decision 72) in a world 131072 x 98304 units (2048 x 1536 m): 32 columns and 24 rows of 64 m cells (4096 units), so its middle (65536, 49152) is in row 12, column 16. Middle is a station there and Edge one 800 m (51200) east of it. Before any land Middle's catchment is empty. setLand lists cells in any order: an office cell at row 12, column 16 with 500 jobs, whose middle (67584, 51200) is within 800 m of Middle, and a home at row 0, column 31 with 7 residents. A cell in column 32 or row 24 is outside the world, and a cell listed twice, both rejected (invalidLand) without changing the land. foundTowns with seed 1 replaces the land with the towns a blank map starts with; here only the first fits, round the middle cell with a radius of 12 cells and 260 residents in its middle cell: a cell d cells away (d^2 < 144) holds 260 x ((144 - d^2) x 1000 / 144) / 1000 residents, rounded down at each step; in its core (9d^2 < 144) shops or offices (drawn per cell from the seed's FNV-1a hash of `town.0.cell.<dr>.<dc>`) with a quarter of those residents and three times as many jobs. Since decision 91 (schema 40) the rest is homes but for a draw of `town.0.district.<dr>.<dc>` (0 to 19): in the inner ring (4d^2 < 144) 0 makes a school or public office (as many jobs as those residents, a quarter of them living there), 1 a sight (as many visitors, no one living there), 2 a park (no one); in the outer ring 0 or 1 makes a factory (twice as many jobs, no one living there); and the three cells beyond the radius (144 <= d^2 < 225) are farms of 3 residents and 8 jobs where `town.0.farm.<dr>.<dc>` (0 to 5) draws 0. So row 12, column 16 (d^2 = 0) is offices, 260 / 4 = 65 residents and 780 jobs; column 19 (d^2 = 9) shops, 243 full, 60 residents and 729 jobs; column 20 (d^2 = 16, 9 x 16 = 144, not the core; 4 x 16 < 144, the inner ring) draws 2, a park with no one (homes with 260 x 888 / 1000 = 230 before decision 91); column 27 (d^2 = 121, the outer ring) draws 0, a factory with 2 x (260 x 159 / 1000) = 82 jobs (41 residents in homes before); column 28 (d^2 = 144) is outside the town and draws no farm. The town is 469 cells with its farms, 44,457 residents and 42,564 jobs (437 cells, 50,189 and 33,276 before decision 91); Middle's 800 m reaches all of it but 21 farms (the farthest cell middle of the town itself is sqrt 143 x 64 ~ 765 m away): 44,394 residents and 42,396 jobs (50,189 and 33,276 before); Edge's catchment is the cells whose middles lie closer than 51200 to (116736, 49152): 19,142 residents and 22,227 jobs (21,555 and 18,558 before). The other two towns lie 2 km or more off the middle in both directions, outside this world. A station that does not exist has no catchment.
